mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate, compressing equity discount rates and boosting forward-looking equity valuations, which translates to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in industrial output (INDPRO) signals stagflation, which increases equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.
